notes.title: Update 1.09: MODES have arrived!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Build 1.09 is here, and it brings a big change - MODES have arrived!

CLASSIC
Play solo or with a friend through a 10-stage match. Choose between Easy or Hard difficulty.

RANDOM
Like CLASSIC, but with a twist: stage order, platform scores, and plane start positions are randomized. Starts on Easy, but ramps up to Hard during your run. Expect the unexpected!

5-LIVES
Just 5 lives - how far can you go? This is a single-player challenge that starts on Easy and keeps escalating without limit. It’s tough, it’s wild, and it’s all about endurance. Good luck!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45152862/9cef14415790e62360d1d8e8cf74fcf06de1461b.png


Other Additions & Tweaks:

 New offline and online leaderboards for RANDOM and 5-LIVES modes
 Naughty 1000pt GOTCHA bonus for knocking opponents into hazards - thanks to WYP for the awesome idea!
 Various minor tweaks and bug fixes


Local Scoreboards Reset
With the introduction of these new modes, the way scores are stored had to be restructured. As a result, your local scoreboards will be reset in this update.

Online leaderboards are unaffected. Your online scores and rankings remain safe.


Thanks for playing Looney Landers! I hope you enjoy the new modes and rise to the challenge.
And stay tuned - a new high score challenge is just around the corner!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Just a quick update on what’s coming next for Looney Landers. Based on your feedback, I’ve been working on some changes, and I wanted to keep you all in the loop.

Just updated
Improved Player Contrast – To make it easier to tell players apart, I originally planned this as an optional setting, but after testing, the change will now be permanent for a better experience all around.

Additional visual cues to better follow the flow of action

Retro Joystick Support – Support implemented for THECXSTICK from Retro Games Ltd. Both the stick and outer ring can be used to control the player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45152862/6ff1c420c18845240a317ae352d1299370a588e4.png

Coming soon
Two New Stages – More variety and longer matches while still keeping that quick arcade-style gameplay. Plus, more chances to grab all those bonus goodies!

Balancing & Tweaks – A long list of adjustments across the board to fine-tune gameplay. Too many details to list, but expect improvements in all departments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45152862/a2b127f6a442aac27a6951309ebce7cf0f0f29d7.png

Later on…
New Game Modes – In addition to Classic, I’m exploring two new modes:
Random Mode and Endless Mode – subject to change and details TBC.
These will take some time since they require new rule sets, but I’m excited to experiment with them.

And beyond that?
Achievements? – I’d love to add Steam achievements, but I need to find a way to hook my hand-made, engine-free code into the Steam SDK. Still looking into it!

High Score Challenges – The recent 500K challenge was a blast! (Congrats to WYP, MIM, and SPY for topping the leaderboard!) In a couple of months, we’ll run another one in Hard Mode. If these become regular events, I might set up a dedicated challenge leaderboard.

The Launch Crash issue
Some players with multi-monitor setups have been experiencing crashes at launch. After consulting with some experts, it seems to be a driver issue affecting certain GPUs. I’ll be testing different screen management methods to improve compatibility and hopefully resolve this issue soon.

That’s all for now! Thanks again for all your feedback and support.
